WHEN: A test step corresponds to multiple automation actions, split the step into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b, etc.), map each sub-step to one script line, and implement all intermediary steps in sequence. Do not skip steps. Step Breakdown: Step 1 → Step 1a → [Script Line 1], Step 1 → Step 1b → [Script Line 2].

WHEN: Executing test cases of type 'Verify the position of the buttons on the 'Cancel shortcut creation' pop up window.', you MUST include implicit/supporting steps such as 'Verify Add New Shortcut screen title' and 'Verify Cancel/Go Back button position and properties', even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps, because they are required to fulfill the purpose of the test case. Include their mapped script lines and intermediary steps. Justification: Required for test case purpose validation.
THEN: Always enforce execution order as defined in intermediary steps and step breakdown. Do not merge multiple script lines into one. Always include purpose-based steps when applicable.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each test step, use the mapped script line(s) and intermediary steps from the correlation and intermediary_steps arrays. For split steps, document each sub-step explicitly and enforce sequential execution. For purpose/supporting steps, reference the test_case_name and include mapped script lines and intermediary steps. Ensure full script coverage, explicit mapping clarity, and no loss of logic.
